name: Salt & pepper squid
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical BBC Good Food / similar salt & pepper squid recipes (400 g squid serves 4 as starter or light lunch).
Total time is active prep + frying time; no passive times given.
Dipping sauce ingredients (cucumber, red onion, rice vinegar, sugar, fish sauce) assumed to form one shared bowl for all servings.
Sunflower oil classified conservatively as absorbed fat only (not a listed diet allergen).
Plain flour confirmed as wheat flour (not gluten-free).
Fish sauce confirms non-vegetarian, non-vegan and presence of fish allergen; squid confirms shellfish allergen.
No milk, egg, tree nuts, peanuts or sesame ingredients listed.
instructions:
step 1
To make the dipping sauce, mix all the ingredients in a small bowl until the sugar has dissolved, then set aside. Mix the cornflour and plain flour with both peppers and 2 tsp sea salt in a large bowl, then set aside. Line a tray with kitchen paper and make sure you have more salt to sprinkle with.

step 2
Heat about 7cm of oil to 180C in a deep fryer, wok or deep pan. If you don’t have a thermometer, you can test it with a cube of bread – it should brown in 20 secs. Coat the squid well with the flour mix and fry in batches for about 2 mins each or until crisp. Use a slotted spoon to lift out the squid, then drain on the kitchen paper and sprinkle with a little more salt. Serve the squid scattered with the spring onion and chilli, with the dipping sauce on the side.

ingredients.name: Corn Flour
ingredients.assumptions: Standard cornflour (cornstarch) values; used as dry coating.

ingredients.name: Plain Flour
ingredients.assumptions: Standard plain white wheat flour values; used as dry coating.

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: Ground black pepper; 2 tsp ≈ 10 g based on typical density of ground pepper.

ingredients.name: Szechuan Peppercorns
ingredients.assumptions: Ground Szechuan peppercorns; 2 tsp ≈ 6 g; typical values for Szechuan pepper.

ingredients.name: Sunflower Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Sunflower oil for deep frying; estimated 40 g absorbed by the 400 g squid across batches (typical 8-12 % absorption for battered fried squid).

ingredients.name: Squid
ingredients.assumptions: Raw squid (edible portion); typical mixed squid values, cleaned and ready to fry.

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: Sliced spring onions (scallions); estimated 20 g as garnish (≈ 2-3 onions).

ingredients.name: Green Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: Sliced green chilli; estimated 15 g (≈ 1 medium chilli) as garnish.

ingredients.name: Red Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: 1 chopped red chilli; estimated 30 g (≈ 1 large chilli) including seeds.

ingredients.name: Cucumber
ingredients.assumptions: ½ cucumber; standard medium cucumber half ≈ 150 g, part of dipping sauce.

ingredients.name: Red Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 1 chopped red onion; standard medium onion ≈ 110 g, part of dipping sauce.

ingredients.name: Rice Vinegar
ingredients.assumptions: Rice vinegar; 100 ml ≈ 100 g, used in dipping sauce.

ingredients.name: Caster Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: Caster sugar; 1 tablespoon ≈ 12 g, used in dipping sauce.

ingredients.name: Fish Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: Fish sauce; 2 tsp ≈ 10 g, used in dipping sauce.
